answer: Eutrophication ki prakriya mein, jal mein aavashyak tatva jaise phosphorus aur nitrogen ki matra badh jaati hai, jisse jal mein jeev-jaantu badh jaate hain aur isse jal ki gunvatta kharab hoti hai. Isse hamein pata chalta hai ki kaise jal ko saaf rakhna chahiye aur kaise iske prabhavon ko kam karna chahiye.

question: Sir, mitosis aur meiosis mein kya antar hota hai?
answer: Mitosis aur meiosis dono cell division ke prakaar hain, lekin mitosis mein do identical cells banti hain jabki meiosis mein chau identical cells banti hain. Meiosis ke dauraan genetic variation hoti hai.
